document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Although  your  expedition  has  failed  to  produce  any  hard 
evidence, your reputation is such that Miskatonic University 
does not hold it against you. However, as the Great Depression 
sets in, you find it more difficult to fund new projects. The bizarre 
stories you have to tell of the North Hanninah are greeted with 
enthusiasm by the sensationalist press, but skepticism by your 
colleagues. As things go, your career manages to survive your 
Hanninah experience.
The Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
